name: gojiberry
description: Connect Gojiberry to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Gojiberry MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Gojiberry to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with b2B lead signals using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Gojiberry workspace.
Find anything in Gojiberry that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review b2B lead signals in Gojiberry.
